version.description: Safe Code project ignore configuration format version.

ignoredWarnings.description: Legacy occurrence ignores matched by path, trimmed line hash, and exact rule ID.

filePath.description: POSIX-style path relative to the workspace folder, not to .vscode.

lineHash.description: First 24 hexadecimal characters of the SHA-256 hash of the trimmed source line.

ruleId.description: Stable Safe Code rule identifier for the warning.

ignoredRules.description: Version 2: exact rule IDs ignored throughout this workspace folder, including future genuine findings. No wildcard matching.
